clues.text: On Mount Carmel, Elijah faced 450 prophets of this god to see which god would answer by fire.
Its prophets on Mount Carmel shouted to it from morning until noon and leaped around their altar, but no one answered.
The LORD told Gideon to tear down his father's altar to this god and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.
After marrying Jezebel, King Ahab built a temple to this god in Samaria and set up an altar in it.
God told Elijah He had kept seven thousand in Israel whose knees had not bowed to this god.
King Jehu called all the servants of this god to a great sacrifice in its temple, then had his guards kill them.
While camped at Shittim, Israelite men were drawn by Moabite women into worshiping this god of Peor.
